name: himothee-studio-streamdeck
description: Native Stream Deck control for Himothee Studio via the localhost Action Registry

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && streamdeck validate com.himothee.studio.sdPlugin --no-update-check
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.himothee.studio.sdPlugin --output dist --no-update-check --force
